subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice timing exception + early-settlement request
messages:
From: Mira Kaur <mira@solacecloud.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + payment terms alignment

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. SolaceCloud is excited to move forward — finance asked that we confirm payment terms and PO timing before we complete onboarding. Our AP team typically asks for Net 45 on new vendor relationships to smooth cashflow while we ramp.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept Net 45 or Net 30 with an early-settlement option?
- What is your PO issuance cadence and invoice-cutoff for recognition (end of month vs. invoice receipt)?

We have attached our W-9 and the vendor details sheet. If you have a standard onboarding packet (vendor_form) we can fill it and return. We also included a sample invoice so you can confirm invoice fields.

If early-settlement is available, we typically propose 2% discount if paid within 10 days (2% 10). Happy to consider alternatives (1% 15, etc.) if that helps you. Goal is to avoid delaying the first PO while payroll timing is tight for us this month.

Thanks — can we get a quick confirmation on next steps and who in finance/procurement we should work with?

Best,
Mira Kaur
Head of Finance Operations
SolaceCloud

Attachments: SolaceCloud_W-9.pdf, SolaceCloud_vendor_details.xlsx, sample_invoice.pdf

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mira Kaur <mira@solacecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + payment terms alignment

Hi Mira — great to meet you yesterday and thanks for the docs.

Quick summary from sales side: Redwood's standard terms are Net 30. We do support negotiated early-settlement programs for strategic vendors; that goes through our AP/Finance for evaluation. I've looped in Karthik (procurement) and Laura (finance) to confirm process and options.

Next steps for us to move the PO and onboarding along:
1) Please complete our vendor onboarding form (I'll attach below / Karthik will send the PDF).
2) Confirm the legal entity name and remit-to address on the sample_invoice so AP can validate.
3) Let us know whether the 2%/10 proposal is firm or if you have flexibility (we can offer alternatives).

Karthik / Laura — Mira is requesting Net 45 (or Net 30 + early-pay). Can procurement/finance advise if we can accommodate 2%/10 or if a counter (1%/15) is more realistic for Redwood? Also please confirm required docs so we can route for signature.

Mira — I'll hold on issuing a PO until procurement confirms the payment path.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: — (Karthik will follow up with onboarding form)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Mira Kaur <mira@solacecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + payment terms alignment

On Sat, Oct 3, 2026 at 10:45 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Mira — can procurement/finance advise if we can accommodate 2%/10 or if a counter (1%/15) is more realistic for Redwood?

Hi all — copying back the attachments and adding our standard vendor_onboarding_form (attached).

Operational notes from procurement:
- Standard flow: sign onboarding form -> confirm remit/legal -> create vendor record -> PO issuance. Typical PO issuance is within one business day after vendor record is validated; invoice cutoff is invoice receipt date (AP processes on next AP run).
- Default payment terms: Net 30. Early-settlement (discount for accelerated payment) is handled by finance and must be approved per vendor/volume.

For commercial offers: if SolaceCloud needs cashflow support, options we typically evaluate are:
- 2% if paid within 10 days (2%/10) — high discount, requires exec approval and depends on anticipated monthly spend; or
- 1% if paid within 15 days (1%/15) — more commonly approved for onboarding periods up to 90 days.

Mira: can you share expected monthly run-rate (rough $ amount) and whether the initial PO is a one-off or recurring? That will help speed approvals.

Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (please complete fields highlighted in yellow).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mira Kaur <mira@solacecloud.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + payment terms alignment

Hi Mira — thanks for the details and the attachments. Apologies for the slight delay — I reviewed the request with AP.

Finance decision (summary):
- Default terms will remain Net 30 for SolaceCloud.
- We can offer an early-settlement option: 1% discount if invoices are paid within 15 calendar days (1%/15) for the first 90 days while you ramp. That avoids executive-level approval and is our standard onboarding concession.
- We are unable to approve 2%/10 at this stage for new vendors unless projected ARR exceeds $250k or there is an executive credit approval.

Operational next steps:
1) Please complete and return the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and confirm your expected monthly spend and remit-to details.
2) Sign the DocuSign onboarding packet (link below) so we can create your vendor record.
3) Once vendor record is live in our AP portal, Redwood will issue the PO and confirm payment-cycle dates. The early-settlement option will be enabled on the AP portal and applied to eligible invoices if elected on the invoice.

DocuSign onboarding link: https://docusign.net/signed/SC-ONBOARD-2026-4872
HubSpot record: hubspot:4872

Attached: sample_invoice.pdf (please match the remit-to and tax IDs exactly).

If you accept the 1%/15 concession, reply with the completed vendor form and we'll route the DocuSign for signature same day.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_invoice.pdf
